messages:
olivia: deploy-bot reports rollout complete for release=v3.1.1 to prod at 2026-02-18T03:31:06Z

deploy-bot: [system] rollout finished: release=v3.1.1 target=prod status=success duration=9m22s

mike: starting post-deploy synthetic suite. Seeing an uptick of 5xxs on /embeddings.fast endpoint — mostly 503 and a couple of 504 timeouts. p95 jumped 160ms -> ~700ms on eu1 probes.

eng-runtime: Observed "shard allocation delay" in runtime logs for model=embed-large-quant. kvcache priming looks delayed for a subset of hosts.

sre-ops: Any gateway 5xx patterns? Could be a bulk warmup plus kv-miss amplification.

laura: gateway traces show upstream 503 with body: "no ready workers for variant=quant-v2". Also seeing pod restarts on two quant nodes (OOMKilled).

olivia: we should avoid a full release rollback if possible. Proposal: quarantine the embedders route and steer it to previous stable version with immediate fallback. Keep global release intact.

mike: redwoodctl supports a route quarantine/pin: `redwoodctl traffic quarantine --route /embeddings.fast --to v3.0.7 --fallback=true --hold 25m`

olivia: deploy-bot, please apply the quarantine and start a 25m hold on further rollout actions. Also mute further automated canaries until we have a fix.

deploy-bot: executing: `redwoodctl traffic quarantine --route /embeddings.fast --to v3.0.7 --fallback=true --hold 25m`

deploy-bot: [success] quarantine applied. route=/embeddings.fast -> v3.0.7, fallback enabled, hold=25m. Traffic shift completed in 11s.

qa-bot: after shift, last 4 synths returned 200 and p95 is ~180ms. Timeouts stopped. :white_check_mark:

eng-runtime: collecting heap profiles + kernel selection traces from affected quant nodes. Saving artifacts and probe payloads to INF-4020. Suspect quant-runtime memory regression for long sequences.

sre-ops: spinning up two extra non-quant spare nodes to absorb load while we triage. Will monitor autoscaler and CPU across quant nodes.

mike: suggestion: run a constrained 0.5% non-quant variant canary in eu1 to validate performance before unquarantining. Command: `redwoodctl traffic split --route /embeddings.fast --variant nonquant --percent 0.5 --duration 10m`

olivia: ok to run the micro-canary but set auto-rollback if error_rate>0.3% or p95>500ms. Keep probe watch and prometheus alert rules active.

laura: creating INF-4020 and assigning to eng-runtime (owners: laura, mike). Adding logs, probe traces, and OOM stack traces.

olivia: decision log: route quarantine applied instead of global rollback; hold window 25m; artifacts saved to INF-4020; micro-canary planned with strict auto-rollback thresholds. If other routes degrade, we escalate to full rollback.

eng-runtime: note for follow-up: reproduce locally with long-seq stress harness, run quant runtime under ASAN and memory profiler.

mike: keeping channel open for updates. Will post canary results in 15m.
